task.title: N2.4 single-capture candidate fan-out
task.objective: Implement awkit-vra.12.4 as re-scoped by the owner: one immutable VisualCaptureFrame per visual decision cycle, cropped deterministically for every candidate (target crop, optional context crop, fingerprint, captureId), with candidate-scoped failures that never recapture, CAPTURE_STALE invalidation on navigation, popup, page close and viewport/DPR change, one protected-surface check before and one after the screenshot, frame release after the cycle and no capture cache. New verify:visual-capture-fanout with mutations A-E, and the fan-out measured against FD-5 in benchmark:visual-fusion. N2 stays shadow-only: MEASURED_FUSION_POLICY.contradictionEnabled stays false; no runner wiring, veto, locator replacement, vision click, OCR, threshold recalibration or persisted capture. The former N2.4 reference store is refiled as its own bead blocking N2.5.

acceptance.description: captureCandidates takes at most one screenshot per cycle whatever the candidate count; every crop is pixel-identical to the element's solo capture and comes from the original frame after a DOM change; candidate failures are scoped and never recapture; navigation, popup, page close, resize and DPR change give CAPTURE_STALE; top-level, iframe and nested-iframe candidates share one screenshot; the protected guard runs once before and once after; frames are released and no listener or capture is retained; mutations A-E each turn verify:visual-capture-fanout red and are restored.

benchmark:visual-fusion measures the fan-out (screenshot count, capture, decode, crops, fingerprints, fusion, total, median, p95) against the same-run sequential path and the N2.3 baseline, and classifies it against the unchanged 400 ms FD-5 budget.
awkit-vra.12.4 is retitled and closed, the reference store is refiled as a new bead blocking awkit-vra.12.5, Beads exported, and verify:roadmap-dashboard reports Sources agree.
The work lands on main and is pushed without force; the L12.27 contract stays untracked and unchanged.
